verdict.rationale: n8n's own docs describe error workflows that control how n8n responds when a workflow execution fails, which covers the core of dedicated error handling. The evidence is a single thin mention, though. Nothing states that a failed run triggers a notification, and per-node error branches inside a workflow are not described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure notifications (e.g., an error workflow sending an alert), in-workflow per-node error paths, detail on error-trigger configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of error workflows.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails

citations.quote: With an error workflow, you can control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure.
